{{Quote|The Pendant of Bone? It is a charm. No monetary value or power.|Biddeck-Va, unaware of Pendant's true purpose|<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=class|[[Empire's Wrath|Sith Warrior]]|Pendant of Bone|[[Voss]]}}</ref>}}
The '''Pendant of Bone''' was a [[Voss (species)|Voss]] artifact that served as a key to the gates of [[Dark Heart|Hall of the Unforgotten]] in the [[Dark Heart]] of the [[Nightmare Lands]], where the [[Emperor's Voice (Sith Empire)|Emperor's Voice]] was trapped for years by [[Sel-Makor]]. Around [[3640 BBY]] the Pendant was in possession of [[Voss commandos|Voss commando]] [[Biddeck-Va]], who was unaware of its function. When the [[Empire's Wrath|Emperor's Wrath]], sent by [[Madaga-Ru]], asked Biddeck-Va for the Pendant, the Commando merely asked the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] to kill a [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] warmaster for him. The Wrath chose to kill Biddeck-Va and his fellow commandos instead.
